meaning: A short-range wireless link. It connects your phone to nearby things like earbuds, speakers, or a car, with no cable.
clues: It lets your phone work with nearby earbuds, a speaker, or a car, with no cable.
It is a short-range link, so the two things need to be fairly close.
You pair two devices once, and after that they can connect on their own.
Its name is the nickname of a king who ruled Denmark long ago.
It has nine letters and starts with B.
assumes: Earbuds, a speaker, and a car are not internet connections
A satellite signal does not play sound from your phone

decoys.meaning: Lets a laptop or tablet get online by using your phone's data.
The internet connection your phone gets through your phone company when it is not on Wi-Fi.
Satellite signals that let a device, such as a phone, work out where it is.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Try it with someone you trust. Open Settings and look for the Bluetooth page. You'll see what your phone is connected to.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: Pair once and it just connects after that? That's better manners than most cords.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Tip: turn it off when you're not using it, to save battery.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: Fun fact: it's named after a king of Denmark and Norway who was nicknamed Bluetooth.
